overview.description: The GraniteShares Short Term Box ETF (LBOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed as an alternative to money market funds and short-term, conservative fixed income. By employing a box spread options strategy, with an average effective maturity of three months,LBOX seeks to deliver T-bill-like returns while minimizing annual income distributions. LBOX was launched on Aug 24, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
